args: Restage only, no opening or release. Measure the achieved post-transfer pose, with the old stalled target retired. Resolve the prior opening-model disagreement by physical boundary identity, not by assuming the bowl moved. Identify the same rigid carton and c0/c1 Cream/C short-end corners in their preserved physical order; return end_camera/end_pixels. Request p0..p5 as six spread-out interior printed-face depth samples, avoiding fingers and seams. They are plane samples, not correspondences. In the clearest bowl view, distinguish the INNER upper opening edge from the OUTER lip silhouette, not a decorative ring on the sloping interior. Return eight angularly distributed inner_pixels and eight corresponding outer_pixels and rim_camera. Return four small convex lip_patches lying strictly on the actual horizontal upper lip, at separated locations. Request d0..d3 as lip depths within these patches and one region lip_surface with explicit camera, tight encompassing box and stride=4. The program will segment this cloud by the patches and test its plane; do not label the whole cloud as isolated. If the lip is too narrow, provide accurate patches for radius-1 depth sampling, or unknown. carton_free concerns separation from external bodies, not fingers. up_route concerns only fixed-current-attitude upward travel of 15 mm and at most 12 mm horizontal recentering; no tilt or descent. opening concerns the current finger envelope expanded by 20 mm on each tool-y side and a 20 mm upward withdrawal, above the bowl. For measured_tops, request o0..o(tops_count-1) at the exposed highest points of ALL nearby external bodies relevant to that local envelope, especially the adjacent green bottle. Use this mode only when visible top shape establishes these samples as local height bounds. only_bowl requires a visible locally empty corridor apart from the bowl below. Self-occlusion is not an obstacle, but a hidden nearby body is not certified absent: use unknown and explain the exact missing relation. No exhaustive scene reconstruction is requested.

end_identity_reference.scope: Physical identity reference only; after movement these pixels are not current measurements.

result.explanation: Measure the achieved pose; the stalled target remains retired. The Cream/C end and printed face support the same rigid carton. The patterned bowl is upright. Its opening is bounded by the inner edge of the narrow upper lip, not the circular decoration on the sloping interior. The near-side outer wall visible beyond the lip is also not the opening boundary. A different fitted radius alone does not establish bowl movement; the earlier fit's physical boundary cannot be verified from its numerical record alone. No opening, release, tilt, or descent is supported by this review.

parameters.notes: c0 is the image-left Cream/C short-end corner, side A; c1 is the image-right counterpart, side B, preserving physical order. p0..p5 are spread-out current printed-face plane samples, not correspondences. Inner and outer boundary lists have matching clockwise angular order, starting at the upper image arc. d0..d3 use radius 1 on the narrow upper-lip patches. Test the segmented lip returns for horizontal coplanarity; reject edge mixing and sloping-wall returns. lip_surface is a mixed bounding-box cloud, not an isolated lip surface. The supplied earlier record is not an earlier image available for direct visual comparison, so stationarity is not independently proven. Carton-free is unknown because the adjacent green bottle overlaps the carton in projection and their hidden separation cannot be established; finger contact is not the reason. The visible space above is open, but the bottle's hidden upper portion is not localized relative to the closed assembly's at-most-12-mm horizontal swept margin, so the combined up_route is unknown rather than obstructed. Opening is independently unknown: the bottle's highest cap/shoulder is not exposed sufficiently to bound its height relative to the fingers expanded by 20 mm on each tool-y side and the 20-mm upward withdrawal. No o samples can establish those missing local height bounds; tops_count is zero, not a claim that no nearby bodies exist. Closed fingers do not establish retention. Fresh selected depths must determine the achieved carton pose and support any retention comparison.
